research.rule: Stargate production costume and prop references first; no historical WNG apparel

sources.title: Val Halverson Q&A hosted by Stargate Atlantis writer/producer Joseph Mallozzi (2008-10-25)
evidence: Wraith costumes were generally three pieces and used roughly 6-8 cow hides plus contrast leather for detail, gauntlets and belts.
Season 4-5 male Wraith were differentiated with subtler details rather than large redesigns.
Todd was treated as tall and regal; costume changes in season 5 were made for actor comfort rather than stated rank coding.
Wraith costumes were operationally difficult because of snaps, Velcro and weight.
Halverson mixed textures deliberately because texture read well in HD.

sources.title: Propworx Stargate Live Auction 2 lot 149 - Wraith costume from The Hive (record mirrored by Stargate-Fusion)
evidence: Green leather trenchcoat with front zipper.
Black reptile-pattern leather vest with epaulettes and decorative reptile-leather panels.
Front snap and zipper closures plus side/back lacing.
Black leather trousers with stretch panel.
Reptile-pattern leather gauntlets with Velcro closures and black leather motorcycle boots.

sources.title: Propstore Wraith costume record (record mirrored by Stargate-Fusion)
evidence: Long jacket, long vest, leather trousers, gauntlets and belt.
Layered textured panels on the upper sleeves build the shoulder form.

sources.title: Propworx Wraith Drone Uniform, lot 68 - production catalogue record
evidence: Black leather under-vest supporting hard-rubber silver front/back carapace.
Rubber simulated-bone thigh, knee and shin protection on black leather components.
Closures use side clasps, snaps, zippers, rear lacing and Velcro.
Use this source for authentic Wraith armour materials and fastening logic only; do not copy the drone rank silhouette into the commander.

required_visual_language: dark green-black soft cowhide leather as the dominant garment material
black reptile-pattern leather inserts and layered shoulder/upper-arm texture
hand-built three-piece Wraith costume logic rather than segmented futuristic plate
visible but restrained lacing, snaps, zippers, clasps and aged dark hardware
production wear: rubbed edges, leather creasing, scuffs and asymmetric use
small command-grade reinforcement using screen-used Wraith hard-rubber silver carapace and simulated-bone material language
regal command presence through silhouette and construction density, not bright colour or neon
rank_and_design_interpretation: Do not invent explicit colour-coded rank language: the available costume-designer evidence says later male Wraith differentiation was subtle.
Commander should read as a refined, heavier version of male Wraith wardrobe, not as a drone in larger armour.
The leather costume is primary; hard-rubber/simulated-bone carapace is secondary reinforcement required by the mod item's armoured gameplay role.
Keep the shoulder treatment layered and textural; avoid geometric pauldrons.
